label: Code Vein sandboxes
description: How Code Vein sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: vortex.

notes: Pak mods go in CodeVein/Content/Paks/~mods, which the game scans after its own paks.
Hard links are the default: the game folder and the staging folder are almost always on one drive, and nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod.
